title: C# Classes & Objects
description: C# is an object-oriented programming language. Everything in C# is associated with classes and objects.

challenges.title: Create Class
challenges.exercise: Create a class named 'Car' with a field 'color = "red"'.

challenges.title: Create Object
challenges.exercise: Create an object of Car named 'myObj' and print myObj.color.

challenges.title: Class Members
challenges.exercise: Add a method 'Honk' to Car that prints 'Beep!'. Call it.

challenges.title: Constructor
challenges.exercise: Create a constructor for Car that sets 'color'. Print new Car("Blue").color.

challenges.title: Inheritance
challenges.exercise: Create a class 'Ford' that inherits from 'Car'. Print 'Inherited'.
